title: Took Much Longer to Bake
text: Took Much Longer to Bake. I was really excited to try these disposable baking pans. What a great idea! Unfortunately, I found them to be just okay. I tried baking a coffee cake. I used a recipe that I had used many times before. I did spray the pan before using. The recipe says to bake it for 30-40 minutes and to test it with a toothpick. After 30 minutes, almost the entire cake was still pretty liquid and it just jiggled. I added 10 more minutes, and there was barely any improvement. I kept adding an additional 7-9 minutes after each time I checked. After I had doubled the cooking time, I took a knife and inserted into the center and it was still batter consistency. The outer edges were lightly browned. I added a total of 10 more minutes before the center was mostly cooked. It was a little soft, but it wasn't batter like any more. I'm guessing it has to do with the material of the pan. Metal pans conduct heat whereas this one doesn't. In the end, my coffee cake was just okay. Of course we ate it, but it was a bit disappointing. I'm probably not going to try using them to bake anymore, but I do think they will work for something such as casseroles.
